column4: Builds the NotPrivate refusal value for a path; the mode/owner decision is made in privately_owned and read_legacy_source.
AuthorityGuard::deref returns a reference to the guarded Option<Authority>; plain accessor, refusal on None happens in the callers.
AuthorityGuard::deref_mut returns a mutable reference to the guarded Option<Authority>; plain accessor with no decision.
AuthoritySlot::new wraps an Authority in a mutex slot with default journeys; inert constructor, no decision.
AccountReleaseAudit::on_release emits a debug log of backend, resource and non-secret revision after the release recheck; observer only, the release decision is made in service.
Maps an AccountState to its accounts.v1 code string; a plain getter.
Serialises error_code and retry flag for the client and omits the seal; formatting only.
Inverse lookup of code() over the two states; conversion only, marked() decides whether to trust the data.
Rewrites a resolver Error::Config into a typed JsonRpc refusal; the refusal was already decided by the resolver and this only tags it.
Renders the caller-visible text of an error; display only.
Converts a marked refusal back to its original Error::Config; the refusal stays a refusal, nothing is decided.
Flushes a directory to disk for durability; decides nothing, privacy is judged elsewhere (private_directory).
Windows directory flush mapped to StorageUnavailable; durability only, privacy judged by private_fs.
Formats the Authorization header value from scheme and token; allow or deny was decided before release.
Returns the current Unix time; no decision.
Trait impl forwarding to CustodyHandle::refresh_after_rejection; the decision lives in the custody service.
Trait impl forwarding to CustodyHandle::refresh_if_expired; the decision lives in the custody service.
Trait impl forwarding to CustodyHandle::release; the lease recheck is made in the custody service.
Trait impl forwarding to CustodyHandle::resolve with no added behaviour; the decision lives in the custody service.
Unwraps run_callback's Result into its outcome; the checks run inside run_callback and its steps.
Writes the terminal reason for an already-refused journey via the store and renders the page; the refusal was decided by the caller.
Runs a store closure via offload and maps offload failure to Unavailable; plumbing, the closure holds the decision.
Journey::page builds a Page outcome from admitted journey fields; plain constructor.
Builds a Page outcome with a root return path; inert constructor.
Maps the provider's error string to a journey status and reason; classification for display and record, no grant is allowed by any arm.
Serialises a JourneyReason to its wire string; formatting.
Maps an already-made store refusal (Replay, Expired, BrowserMismatch) to a page or Invalid outcome; the decision is made in the store's admit_callback.
Maps a ProviderRevocation outcome to a status string; formatting.
